notes.title: July 1, 2024 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Enhanced Control Over Your Desktop Shortcuts[/h1]

We're thrilled to introduce a new option for managing the arrows on the lower-left corner of your desktop shortcuts, exclusively for 64-bit systems. This marks a testament to our commitment to user customization and personalization.

With this update, we're empowering you with greater control over the look and feel of your icons, aligning with our desire to respect each user's preferences in how they best represent their workspace.

[b]Please note:[/b] This feature is currently unavailable for 32-bit systems.

notes.title: New Language Options and Image-to-Icon Feature Added!
notes.content:
Dear Kz Icon Center Users,

We're excited to announce the latest update to Kz Icon Center, bringing you some exciting new features to enhance your experience. This update aims to make our platform more user-friendly and enrich your usage.

[h2][b]New Language Options:[/b][/h2]
We're thrilled to introduce 6 new language options to Kz Icon Center, including German, Turkish, Czech, French, Italian, and Russian. With these new language options, you can now use Kz Icon Center in your preferred language, making it more accessible and inclusive.

[h2][b]Image-to-Icon Feature:[/b][/h2]
With this update, we're introducing the Image-to-Icon feature, allowing you to easily convert your images into custom icons within Kz Icon Center. Simply upload any image file through the interface, and create personalized icons for your profiles or collections. This feature adds a new level of customization to your experience.

[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
In addition, this update includes various bug fixes and improvements to enhance the overall performance and reliability of Kz Icon Center. We've addressed several issues to ensure a smoother experience for all users.

We value your feedback on this update and encourage you to share your thoughts with us. Thank you for helping us make Kz Icon Center better with each update!

Best regards,
Kz Icon Center Team
